project.objective: Locate Josiah Barnes (b. c. 1818, Massachusetts) and his household in the 1855 Massachusetts State Census

questions.question: Where was Josiah Barnes enumerated in the 1855 Massachusetts State Census, and who was in his household?
questions.rationale: The 1855 Massachusetts State Census is one of the two surviving state schedules and should place the subject's household mid-decade, between the 1850 and 1860 federal censuses.

items.rationale: MyHeritage indexes the 1855 Massachusetts State Census; the researcher has a MyHeritage subscription, so this search is immediately actionable.
